gap_decomposition.note: self2 recovery vs the EXACT input map under one confound at a time (scripts/ascertain_decomp.py, demog_decomp.py). Attributes the drop from clean-sim; truth-noise (0.88 exact->0.55 real reference) is separate and dominant.
gap_decomposition.verdict: ascertainment ~0.06, structure ~0.00, expansion ~0.12; NONE reproduces the drop to 0.34 -> the dominant limit is truth-map noise (Salome<->Rowan ceiling 0.55), not a fixable modelling gap.

celegans_transfer.note: Frozen A. thaliana-trained self2 (NO retraining) recovering the C. elegans RockmanRIAIL_ce11 map (arm-centre domain structure) from clean sim. Generality of the amortized selfing model across selfers.
celegans_transfer.map_resolution: RockmanRIAIL_ce11 is ~1 anchor/2Mb (very coarse); recovery is the broad domain structure
